newsitem.title: JAPAN: Dollar hits 111 yen in post-G7 Tokyo--traders.
newsitem.headline: Dollar hits 111 yen in post-G7 Tokyo--traders.

text.p: The dollar hit 111.00 yen in early morning trade in Tokyo on Monday for the first time since July 8, buoyed by buying by Japanese securities firms and trust banks, dealers said.
On July 8, the dollar touched its year high of 111.20 yen.
Offers from automobile firms at 111.00 yen emerged to cap gains, one dealer said.
This past weekend's meeting of Group of Seven (G7) finance ministers and central bank heads did little more than confirm current dollar trends, he added.
